'''Malé-Dee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], serving as a member of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] and later the [[Delegation of 2000]].

==Biography==
[[File:Male-Dee2000.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Malé-Dee in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] office]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Malé-Dee was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]], hailing from the world's [[Visdic territories]].<ref name="db" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="DioDeath">{{InsiderCite|76|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:29}} is set on the date 15:3:29, which corresponds to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], his homeworld's [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]], was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]]. The citizens of Uyter eventually elected Malé-Dee to occupy the senatorial position she held.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Like his predecessor,<ref name="db" /> he became a member of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]].<ref name="CSWE" />

It was believed by his constituents that Malé-Dee would be less outspoken than his predecessor, and would take her place on the Loyalist Committee. Malé-Dee proved them wrong, however, and he too grew suspicious over [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] growing power over the Senate. Near the end of the war, Malé-Dee joined the [[Delegation of 2000]], which presented Palpatine with the [[Petition of 2000]]; this document called for the Supreme Chancellor to relinquish his burgeoned powers at the war's conclusion, and denounced the renewed position of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. Palpatine was enraged by the screed, declaring its signatories to be traitors.<ref name="ROTS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] senator stood at 1.68 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="db" /> Malé-Dee's hairstyle, styled in a way that signified a plea for peace, had his red [[Hair/Legends|hair]] start at the top of his forehead and run over his skull before terminating at the nape of his neck.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|280|Malé-Dee}}</ref> He had a unique appearance<ref name="Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook]]''</ref> and fashion statements were important to him.<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> Compared to Lexi Dio, he was considerably less confrontational and more soft-spoken.<ref name="db" />

==Equipment==
Malé-Dee's unique appearance was enhanced<ref name="Scrapbook" /> by the traditional<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Visdic body wrappings]] he wore.<ref name="Scrapbook" /> The wrappings, denoting his humble roots, were from the Visdic territories of Uyter.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malé-Dee first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], written by [[Matthew Stover]]<ref name="ROTS novel" /> and released on [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="ROTS novel release date">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=30059|text=Matthew Woodring Stover}}</ref> In ''Revenge of the Sith'' itself, Malé-Dee's portrayal was credited to [[Kee Chan]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> with the landing pad scenes featuring the character shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 22]], 2003.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> A scene featuring the character bringing the Petition of 2000 to the Supreme Chancellor was cut from the film<ref name="ROTS" /> but adapted in the novelization.<ref name="ROTS novel" />

Malé-Dee's name comes from his simple identification as "Male Senator" during pre-production character design.<ref name="Who's Who" /> He was first pictured prior to the release of ''Revenge of the Sith'' by ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook]]'', written by [[Ryder Windham]]<ref name="Scrapbook" /> and released simultaneous to the ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization<ref name="ROTS novel release date" /> on April 2, 2005,<ref name="Date">{{Amazon|url=/Revenge-Sith-Scrapbook-Star-Wars/dp/0375826114|text=Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook (Star Wars)|archivedate=20160528170422}}</ref> though his name was misspelled as "Malé Dee."<ref name="Scrapbook" />
